jobs.title: WMS Engineer
jobs.description:
**Jouw uitdaging**
------------------


Als **WMS Engineer** help je ons bij de verdere uitrol en doorontwikkeling van ons cloud\-based **Blue Yonder (Warehouse Management Systeem)** dat draait op 3 locaties (Aalsmeer, Naaldwijk en Rijnsburg) en dagelijks wordt gebruikt door honderden operationele gebruikers met state\-of\-the\-art mobiele devices.


Je werkt in een omgeving met serieuze schaal en impact: **2,4 miljoen m²** vastgoed, gemiddeld **100\.000 klantorders per dag** en circa **30\.000 trolleys per dag**. Het platform wordt gehost en ondersteund door Blue Yonder, inclusief het Snowflake reporting platform en first\-line support.


In deze rol speel je een sleutelrol in het opbouwen van interne Warehouse Management expertise. Waar we nu nog intensief samenwerken met een implementatiepartner, neem jij stap voor stap meer verantwoordelijkheid over.


Je analyseert processen, vertaalt veranderingen naar functionele specificaties, voert configuraties en basic development uit en begeleidt integratietesten en deployments. Bij complexe vraagstukken werk je nauw samen met onze implementatiepartner en het Blue Yonder productteam.


Als onderdeel van onze internationale **SAFe en Agile organisatie**, sluit je aan bij de **Logistics ART**, waarin je samenwerkt met 8 teams verspreid over Europa.

**Wat ga je doen?**
-------------------


Als **Blue Yonder WMS Engineer** werk je nauw samen met de Product Owner Logistics en draag je actief bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze WMS\-roadmap. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in de verdere uitrol van het platform en in innovatieve projecten rondom robotisering en automatisering.


Je vertaalt businessbehoeften naar slimme oplossingen door:

* **Requirements** op te halen en uit te werken in user stories en designopties
* **Oplossingen te configureren,** bouwen en testen binnen Blue Yonder
* **Intensief samen te werken** met interne teams en externe partners om kwaliteit te waarborgen


Daarnaast:

* Ondersteun je go\-lives en hypercare fases op locatie
* Ben je hét aanspreekpunt voor WMS\-vraagstukken (functioneel, technisch en database)
* Coördineer je supportcases en stem je af met Blue Yonder
* Zorg je voor heldere documentatie en verzorg je trainingen voor key users
* Bewaak je de performance en continuïteit van het systeem
* Heb je met **Blue Yonder WMS** en logistieke processen.
* Kennis van **MOCA** voor het ontwikkelen en beheren van maatwerkoplossingen binnen Blue Yonder.
* Ervaring met **Groovy scripting** voor automatiseringen, integraties en systeemuitbreidingen.


Kortom: een veelzijdige rol waarin je techniek, processen en stakeholders samenbrengt om functionele wensen te vertalen naar technische oplossingen binnen het WMS\-landschap van Royal FloraHolland!

**Ons aanbod**
--------------

* Een team met een positieve werksfeer en een echte **can\-do mentaliteit**
* Een werkweek van **32 tot 38 uur per week**
* Een salaris (o.b.v. 38 uur) van € 4\.938 tot € 7\.006 volgens de cao
* Hybride werken vanuit onze locaties in **Aalsmeer en Naaldwijk**, gecombineerd met thuiswerken
* **27 vakantiedagen** bij een fulltime dienstverband
* Een laptop en telefoon
* **5x per jaar een plantcadeau**
* Ruime ontwikkel\- en doorgroeimogelijkheden via onze Academy
* Werken bij een unieke coöperatie: de grootste marktplaats voor bloemen en planten in Europa

**Meer informatie?**
--------------------


Een online screening en referentie check maken deel uit van het sollicitatieproces, net als de aanvraag van een verklaring omtrent gedrag (VOG).

***Werk je bij een bureau en wil je een kandidaat voorstellen voor deze vacature bij Royal FloraHolland? Bedankt, maar hier gaan we niet op in. We werven onze nieuwe collega graag zelf.***

jobs.description:

* Support the editorial process for academic research journals in your domain of expertise
* Organize peer review process for submitted manuscripts and coordinate editorial decisions
* Handle email communication between the parties involved in the publication process
* Collaborate with other members of the editorial team and production team
* Ensure that scholarly articles are accurately edited and published according to tight deadlines with a high degree of consistency

* A PhD (preferred) or Master's degree in a field related to: **Electrical \& Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering / Computer Science**,**Telecommunication / Information Engineering**, **Automation \& Control Engineering**, **Microelectronics / Semiconductor Devices / Photonics, Mechatronics Engineering, Biomedical Engineering**, **Physics / Applied Physics**, **Materials Science**

jobs.title: Programmer (Entry Level) – SQL & Data Programming
jobs.description:
**Role overview**


This is an entry\-level role for someone who wants to build a career in data programming and database development. Working primarily in Microsoft SQL Server, you will help load, process and maintain the data behind customer data platforms for a range of blue\-chip brands, making sure the information our clients rely on to give their customers relevant, personalised experiences is accurate, connected and delivered on time.


This role is based out of our London office with an expectation to be in the office at least 1 day per week.

**About Plinc**


Since 2001, Plinc has been helping big consumer brands boost their relevance, resonance and revenue. We’ve got a unique approach to connecting, analysing, and harnessing data that helps turn casual customers into consistent buyers.


We are a group of solutions\-focused data experts passionate about helping our clients achieve amazing things, whether it’s through expertly engineered data platforms or innovative analytics (such as machine learning and AI\-driven solutions) or strategic planning. We work with some of the world’s biggest and most respected brands and are at an exciting time in our evolution, with ambitious plans to scale our solutions and reach an even broader audience.


If you are looking for a role in a nurturing, fun, people\-focused environment and welcome the chance to test your skills working with super\-ambitious brands, then this is the opportunity for you. We invest in our people and promote personal development, offering training and support for growth and a range of employee benefits.

**What you'll be doing**


You will start with around a month of intensive, full\-time training in SQL and in the way we write and structure code, learning on a live client dataset so you understand what data we hold, how it joins together and the processes that run on it, alongside the other tools we use.

**By your second or third month you will be contributing to client work, which includes:**

* Running daily QA checks on data feeds and processes that load client data into our systems, then fixing issues or escalating them where needed
* Writing and maintaining SQL scripts and processes for data extraction, transformation and loading, including SSIS packages
* Integrating new data into customer data platforms, including our proprietarycloud\-based Unilyze platform and marketing tools such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Apteco FastStats
* Producing data extracts, reports and campaign selections to specification and to schedule
* Documenting data and workflow processes and suggesting improvements
* Building skills beyond SQL as you progress, including Azure, APIs and C\#

Programmers at Plinc learn a wide range of technical skills quickly and work on a constantly changing mix of clients and projects, within a supportive framework that still gives you room to put your own ideas forward. There may be future opportunities to move into **data engineering** and potentially become involved in the **development of our products/platforms.**

**About You**


You don’t need commercial SQL experience, as we will train you from the ground up. If you don’t have SQL, then you will need to have written code in another language (such as in Python, R or Java).


You will need to bring strong numeracy and a logical, analytical way of thinking. The bar is high, and so is the investment we make in the people who join us.

**What you’ll bring**

* Programming experience in any language, gained through study, personal projects or work; SQL is an advantage but not essential
* Excellent numeracy and a logical, analytical approach to solving problems
* Exceptional attention to detail and a methodical approach to checking your own work
* Clear, confident communication and a real appetite for working as part of a team
* A strong interest in technology and data, and the ability to pick up new skills quickly
* Not essential but highly beneficial \- a degree, or equivalent education/training/experience, in maths, science, engineering, computing or another numerate subject.

**And in return, Plinc offers**

* Salary: £30,000
* Bonus scheme
* 25 days’ annual leave, plus additional days with service
* Holiday Purchase Scheme – buy/sell up to 5 days
* 2 community volunteering days
* Hybrid working
* Flexible working practices
* Ongoing Training \& Development
* Health \& Wellbeing package
* Financial Health (pension, life assurance, etc.)
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Team \& Company Socials


Full details of local benefits and perks available on request from the People Team (HR).

**Why Join Us**


Our solutions and services help some of the leading brands in the UK solve the most complex marketing challenges, embracing the latest technological innovation to better connect, analyse and activate their data.


Part of the vibrant Savanta \& Next 15 Communications Group, we have an entrepreneurial and inclusive company culture that actively recognises and values its people, and offers unrivalled scope for career development, including mentoring, coaching and extensive training programmes.


Plinc is committed to being an equal opportunities employer and continuously strives to be an employer of choice. jobs.description:

OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly a century, we've been the foundation the travel industry builds on, trusted, proven, essential. Today, we're going beyond.



We combine unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise to deliver what the industry truly needs: not just more data, but better answers. From real\-time operational intelligence to strategic decision\-making, we power the entire travel ecosystem, from airlines and airports to technology companies and financial institutions.



We are actively embedding AI throughout our intelligence layer, combining nearly a century of proprietary data with the latest technology to deliver answers that were simply not possible before.



We exist because travel moves the world, and we move travel. By transforming complexity into clarity and questions into answers, we give our partners the intelligence they need to thrive in an evolving world. For more information visit www.oag.com

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**



OAG Digital is the team turning our world\-class data into a product\-led growth engine. A unified experience where customers can sign up, explore, and extract value on their own.



You'll work across two areas. Core is the platform backbone \- identity, auth, entitlements, billing, and the infrastructure everything else depends on. Intelligence is the layer above the data \- AI\-powered insights, predictive models built on Databricks and Snowflake, anomaly detection, and agentic features.



This is a full\-stack role. You'll own features from the data layer to the customer\-facing interface. We care about UX as much as throughput, and we're AI\-native \- tooling is part of how we develop, not an afterthought.

  

**This role can be worked remotely from anywhere in the UK only. Please note that we're unable to offer visa sponsorship, so applicants will need the existing right to work in the UK.**


**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**


* Own features end\-to\-end \- from problem\-shaping with Product and Design through implementation, testing, production releases and future enhancements
* Build customer\-facing experiences and the backend systems and data models behind them
* Evolve platform architecture across Core and Intelligence for scalability, reliability, and sustainability
* Lead technical decisions and engineering strategy, balancing innovation with pragmatism
* Build core platform capabilities: auth, entitlements, billing integrations, and usage management
* Integrate AI models, data pipelines, and event\-driven systems on Databricks and Snowflake into the Intelligence layer
* Maintain the quality bar through code reviews, automated testing, observability, and CI/CD
* Support junior and mid\-level engineers and help them grow
  


**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**


* Extensive full\-stack experience building and shipping production\-grade systems
* Strong front\-end skills (React, TypeScript, or equivalent) with genuine care for great web interfaces
* A builder's mindset. You understand the who and the why, and you own what ships.
* Strong C\# (or comparable OO language) and confidence across the full stack
* Solid system\-design knowledge (scalability, reliability, security) and the ability to defend architectural trade\-offs
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, and DevOps practices
* Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases, and comfort working with data at scale
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead \- not just contribute to \- technical decisions
* Clear communicator who works directly with Product and Design and can shape problems as well as solve them
* AI\-native in how you develop \- you use AI tooling daily and expect the same from your team
  


**IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU ALSO HAD**


* Experience with Databricks or Snowflake, particularly in analytical or data\-intensive contexts
* Familiarity with AI/ML in production: model serving, prompt pipelines, or agentic patterns
* Experience with consumption\-based and subscription billing
* Experience with self\-serve billing platform integrations
* Exposure to aviation, travel, or data\-as\-a\-service businesses
* Experience standing up or significantly improving engineering foundations for a new product or team
* A portfolio showing you've raised the bar on UX, performance, or product craft


If you don't meet every requirement but feel excited about this role, we'd still love to hear from you.

  


**WE WILL OFFER YOU:**



 You will proactively explore and adopt AI tools and automation in your day\-to\-day work, keeping the customer at the centre of everything you do. You will share learnings with your team and approach new technologies with curiosity and an open mind. At OAG, finding better ways to work and putting customers first is everyone's responsibility.



 Real responsibility on hard problems, with the autonomy to own decisions and act on them, in an open culture built on trust.



 Flexible working arrangements that allow remote work or office attendance



 An attractive compensation and benefits package, including private health insurance, a company bonus scheme and enhanced pension scheme



️ 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, and a day off during your birthday month


* Octopus EV salary sacrifice scheme



 Work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 1 month per year



 Annual learning and development budget.

  



OAG is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to perform at their best.



We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know — we're happy to have an open conversation about how we can support you.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
***Company Description***

*We’re**Checkout.com**. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.*

  

*We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.*  

  

*Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.*  

  

*If you want to do career\-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*  

  

*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*


As a Staff Engineer at Checkout.com, you will set the technical direction for systems that process payments at very high throughput, where correctness matters on every single transaction and has significant impact. This is a role for engineers who are energised by scale and by the hard trade\-offs that come with it: latency budgets, failure domains, consistency guarantees, and the operational reality of running critical infrastructure around the clock.  

  

You will operate as a force multiplier across multiple teams \- shaping architecture, raising the engineering bar, and turning ambiguous, business\-critical problems into designs that can be delivered incrementally. We're looking for individuals with deep technical judgement, strong ownership, and a pragmatic approach to breaking big problems into smaller iterations that deliver value continuously.  

  

**How you'll make an impact**

* Own the architecture of high\-throughput, low\-latency distributed systems, defining the service boundaries, data models and integration patterns that let them scale by an order of magnitude
* Design for resilience from first principles \- redundancy, graceful degradation, backpressure, idempotency and recovery \- so that partial failures never become customer\-facing outages
* Set and defend the non\-functional requirements that matter: availability targets, latency percentiles, throughput ceilings, data durability and recovery objectives

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description:
**Who we are**


4C Strategies builds readiness and resilience software for defence, public safety and critical infrastructure organisations in more than 70 countries. Our Exonaut platform is used to plan, run and evaluate large\-scale training, exercises and capability evaluations, and our consultants and engineers work alongside those organisations across Europe, North America and beyond.

**What we're building**


We're building the evidence layer for defence experimentation and evaluation. When an organisation tests a new capability — a sensor, an autonomous system, a different way of operating — it has to be able to defend the result afterwards, to someone who was not there and who has every reason to challenge it. Today that evidence lives in spreadsheets, documents and standalone survey tools, and it cannot be traced from a conclusion back to the observation that supports it.


Our platform fixes the structure before the data is collected, captures evidence from people and from machines, fuses it into chains that carry their own provenance, and keeps every finding traceable to its source. The hard part is not the plumbing. It is holding one coherent model steady while every customer arrives with their own vocabulary, their own method and a reasonable\-sounding request for one more special case.

**How we build**


Modern Java — currently 25 — and Spring Boot on a modular JPMS architecture, an Angular 21 single\-page application, PostgreSQL with PostGIS, deployed to Kubernetes.


The principles are conservative on purpose. Dependency inversion at every module boundary: contracts in an API module, implementation separate, no reverse dependencies. Schema evolution is explicit and reversible, through migrations with rollback scripts and no auto\-DDL in any environment. Evolutionary change over rewrites, with a staged path when a domain concern outgrows its boundary. Structural decisions are argued in RFCs and recorded in ADRs, and changes to the core domain model go through that process rather than around it — because that model is the product, and it is the thing most easily damaged under delivery pressure.


Three constraints shape most of what we do. It runs inside the customer's own environment: single\-tenant, sovereign, accredited, sometimes with no route to the internet at all, so nothing may assume a managed cloud service. Evidence has to be captured where the work happens, which means a tablet in a field with no connectivity and a sync that loses nothing. And the audit trail is immutable — evidence cannot be quietly deleted or backdated, and no automated process publishes a conclusion without a person taking responsibility for it.

**You**


We are a small team, so you will work across the stack rather than behind a specialism. Substantial experience in either Java or TypeScript, and a genuine willingness to be useful in the other. Sound judgement about data modelling, because most of the interesting problems here are modelling problems wearing engineering clothes. Comfortable with ambiguity: requirements move, and the shape of the answer is often the work.


A real advantage, though none of it is required: sovereign, air\-gapped or accredited deployments; offline\-first or sync\-heavy applications; geospatial data; sensor, telemetry or simulation integration; audit and traceability requirements. The domain is learnable, the judgement less so.


The team is small enough that your work is visible and your arguments carry. Your designs will be challenged and you will be expected to challenge back — including on scope.


Research shows some people only apply when they meet every requirement. If you don't tick every box but recognise yourself in much of the above, please apply anyway. We'd genuinely like to hear from you.

**Security and citizenship**


This role supports defence work, so the successful candidate must hold Swedish citizenship and pass Swedish security vetting (säkerhetsprövning). We will explain what the check involves early in the process rather than late — a requirement like this should never be a surprise at offer stage.


This requirement comes only from the security rules that govern defence work, not from personal preference.

**Why it matters**


Capability decisions get made on this evidence. When an organisation concludes that something is ready, or that it is not, that judgement has consequences for the people who depend on it. Making it defensible is the whole point.

**How we hire**


Every interview has a written script and a scored rubric, applied the same way to every candidate.

* **Hiring Manager Screen** — a conversation about your experience, how you work and what


you want next.

* **System Design** — a design discussion drawn from problems like the ones above.
* **Programming** — a hands\-on session in a language of your choice (Java, C\#, TypeScript,


Python or Go).

* **Culture Interview** — how you collaborate, disagree and make decisions with others.
* **Candidate Q\&A** — your time to interrogate us. We expect you to use it.


We then debrief as a panel and decide. We review applications on a rolling basis.

**What you can expect from 4C Strategies**

* Stockholm\-based, with hybrid working.
* Competitive salary, reviewed annually.
* Occupational pension (tjänstepension).
* Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag).
* Healthcare insurance, including insurance for treatment.
* Parental pay.
* Vaccinations.
* A supportive, collaborative team building meaningful products for mission\-critical work.

**Why join 4C Strategies**


This is a small team with a large surface. You will not be handed a narrow lane: the platform is still being shaped, the domain model is still being argued about, and the person who makes the argument well is the person who decides. If you would rather own a hard, open problem end to end than take tickets from a backlog, that is the job.


The work matters: what you build helps defence, public safety and resilience organisations prepare for the situations they hope not to face.

**How to apply**


To apply, click the Apply today button and submit your CV. A short cover note on your experience and motivation is welcome but not required. We review applications on a rolling basis, so please apply as soon as you can.


4C Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
